dct_description_sm: Presents socio-demographic information of York Region’s population and is aggregated from Statistics Canada’s Census data. For reference purposes, York Region data is compared to those of Ontario, Canada, the Greater Toronto Area and York Region local municipalities.
dct_rights_sm: Please refer to "York Region Open Data Licence", searchable on this website.
